blocks.text: Object specification for api.spawn(spec) Creates a new object in the world: its fields (feetPosition, primitive, material, physics, …) sit flat beside id, tags, state, behavior, children.

ObjectSpec = ObjectProperties & { id?: string // minted when omitted; a placement's id tags?: string[] place?: string // default: the parent's place, else the spawning script's place at that moment (the world's sim.js: the default place unless ctx.place moved it) audience?: ObjectAudience // who sees it: "near" (default: the ring around it) | "all" (everyone in the world, from any place, however far: a global manager, a boss, a stage) | "local" (only this machine) simulatedBy?: PlatformDial // who simulates it, "platform": the row runs only on Spawn's own machine, never on a player's client, even in a room of one (an economy row, a dealer, a bank); omitted: one machine simulates it as any row. `obj.simulatedBy = "platform"` flips it live and saves it on the row visibility?: ObjectVisibility // who may hear it at all: absent (the default: everyone the audience names) | "owner" (its owner's screen alone, the player whose body carries it or whose session spawned it, plus Spawn's own machine, the creator and Savi: a card hand) | "platform" (Spawn's own machine, the creator and Savi alone: a deck) lifetime?: number // seconds, then destroyed scope?: "session" | "world" // "session": dies when the spawning player leaves; "world" (default) outlives them retention?: ObjectRetention // "none": shared live, never saved; every player in its audience sees it, nothing of it is kept, a player who joins later sees it from its next word, and it leaves when its spawner leaves; omitted (default): kept for the room state?: TomeState behavior?: BehaviorRef // "scripts/x.js" | [...]; at runtime obj.behavior.push("scripts/y.js") attaches children?: ObjectSpec[] // A thing made of pieces is ONE spawn: light, fx, sound too are its children at local offsets; move the root, the thing moves. A child's id is local to its root (the entity is `<root>/<id>`, so one template's `flame` serves every placement). With `template`: each child here merges onto the template's child of the same id (or, when that child has no id, the same seat, which your id then names), and says only what changes: `{ id: "flame", state: { seed } }` keeps the template flame's sprite, light and behavior; a child the template lacks is added; null or [] = no children parent?: string // "player" on a template root = each player's composed body, stamped per player template?: string // "templates/archway.js#archway": spawn that template's def; the placement names the template (edit the file, every placement follows) and the fields beside it are this one's overrides overrides?: Record<string, unknown> // with `template`: this placement's pairs in the scene entry's spelling: { "feetPosition": {…}, "state.link": "…", "children.flame.light.intensity": 2, "children.lamp": null } (the fields / state / tags beside it say the same; `children.<id>` reaches one template child by its id, null there removes it) }

code.text:
ObjectSpec = ObjectProperties & {
  id?: string   // minted when omitted; a placement's id
  tags?: string[]
  place?: string   // default: the parent's place, else the spawning script's place at that moment (the world's sim.js: the default place unless ctx.place moved it)
  audience?: ObjectAudience   // who sees it: "near" (default: the ring around it) | "all" (everyone in the world, from any place, however far: a global manager, a boss, a stage) | "local" (only this machine)
  simulatedBy?: PlatformDial   // who simulates it, "platform": the row runs only on Spawn's own machine, never on a player's client, even in a room of one (an economy row, a dealer, a bank); omitted: one machine simulates it as any row. `obj.simulatedBy = "platform"` flips it live and saves it on the row
  visibility?: ObjectVisibility   // who may hear it at all: absent (the default: everyone the audience names) | "owner" (its owner's screen alone, the player whose body carries it or whose session spawned it, plus Spawn's own machine, the creator and Savi: a card hand) | "platform" (Spawn's own machine, the creator and Savi alone: a deck)
  lifetime?: number   // seconds, then destroyed
  scope?: "session" | "world"   // "session": dies when the spawning player leaves; "world" (default) outlives them
  retention?: ObjectRetention   // "none": shared live, never saved; every player in its audience sees it, nothing of it is kept, a player who joins later sees it from its next word, and it leaves when its spawner leaves; omitted (default): kept for the room
  state?: TomeState
  behavior?: BehaviorRef   // "scripts/x.js" | [...]; at runtime obj.behavior.push("scripts/y.js") attaches
  children?: ObjectSpec[]   // A thing made of pieces is ONE spawn: light, fx, sound too are its children at local offsets; move the root, the thing moves. A child's id is local to its root (the entity is `<root>/<id>`, so one template's `flame` serves every placement). With `template`: each child here merges onto the template's child of the same id (or, when that child has no id, the same seat, which your id then names), and says only what changes: `{ id: "flame", state: { seed } }` keeps the template flame's sprite, light and behavior; a child the template lacks is added; null or [] = no children
  parent?: string   // "player" on a template root = each player's composed body, stamped per player
  template?: string   // "templates/archway.js#archway": spawn that template's def; the placement names the template (edit the file, every placement follows) and the fields beside it are this one's overrides
  overrides?: Record<string, unknown>   // with `template`: this placement's pairs in the scene entry's spelling: { "feetPosition": {…}, "state.link": "…", "children.flame.light.intensity": 2, "children.lamp": null } (the fields / state / tags beside it say the same; `children.<id>` reaches one template child by its id, null there removes it)
}
